'''This''' [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] took [[Padawan]] [[Shen-Ji Collun]] as the Jedi's apprentice during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi Master told Collun that she was now two months away from undergoing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], and becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="FOR" />
